meta.title: Tactical Briefing Boot
meta.description: A four-beat holographic mission-briefing opening. The theater reveal starts uncolored: a solid white-hot point rises and bursts a dense ray fan while the sector fill rises from below; the rays clear quickly, the solid point lingers then fades, leaving only the key nodes. Holographic command-table uplink, operator access / systems check and a mission-start title complete the sequence. The map and HUD are drawn in code; Agnes generates only the terrain relief and holographic table plates. About 15 seconds, skippable, played once per application start.
